params.body:
A second pass over `/communities/cybersec` after the recap went live, in en, nl and fr, plus two small changes to the card on `/communities`.

## The top of the page

- **Lead.** Written as the community speaking: a cybersecurity community in The Gambia for students and professionals, practising together on real challenges, which strengthens education without replacing it.
- **Three statements in place of three cards.** No boxes: three columns on the page ground with a thin rule between them, stacked on a phone. They say what you do when you come (KUBO computer labs, real hardware, mentors, talks), who it is for (you need to know your way around a computer, not security), and how to join (the Signal group, through the community lead).
- **Titles in IBM Plex Mono Bold** after a coral prompt, echoing the keycap sticker. The font is one self-hosted 15 kB file (SIL Open Font License) that only this page loads.
- **Flag.** The Gambian flag sits in the eyebrow, taken from a country code so a community in another country only changes that code.
- **Sticker and title.** The keycap is smaller (260 px, 180 on a phone) and the title is no longer capped at 20 characters, so it fits on one line from about 1100 px.

## The recap

- **Photos replace the poster.** Three photos of the day: the group, a member of the community at a laptop, and one participant helping two others. Resized to 960 and 480 px webp with camera data stripped; the group photo is also the social image. No participant is named in text, alt text or image.
- **Title.** "Capture the Flag, November 2026", which makes the "Took place" pill and the separate When row unnecessary.
- **Facts.** One ranking is no longer mentioned, the organiser row is gone because KUBO is a project of Afrodidact, and the Setup row lists what was hosted for the participants: a Linux machine each, the scoreboard, tutorials, CyberChef and the AI tutor.
- **Invitation.** The box under the facts is a quote from the community lead inviting visitors to message him to be added to the Signal group, with his photo, name and role.

## The contact number is back, encoded

The invitation ends in a "Show number" button, the mechanism the page had before the event. The HTML carries only the encoded form from `src/lib/contact.js`; the number and the link to call it are created in the browser on click. Without JavaScript the box points to info@kubo.global. No digits and no `wa.me` link are in the built site, and `npm run check:built` passes.

## The communities page

- The KUBO CyberSec card shows the Gambian flag next to the country name.
- The yellow bar across the top of that card is removed.

## Checked

- `npm test`: 25 tests pass.
- `npm run build`, then `npm run check:built`: 80 text files, no contact number.
- The button was clicked in a headless browser: the number appears in the expected format with a matching `tel:` link.
- Looked at in a browser at 1440, 1000 and 390 px.

## Not in this pull request

- The poster files stay in `public/communities/`, unused by the page, because the JPG may be linked from messages sent before the event.
- "From first steps to advanced" still stands in the page's meta description and on the card on `/communities`.
params.title: CyberSec page: community voice, photos of the day, joining through the lead
